question.text: The Senior Citizens' Saving Scheme (SCSS) is available to individuals aged 60 years or above. For individuals retiring under VRS, the minimum age eligibility is reduced to:

answer.text: No reduction in age limit for VRS retirees

explanation.text: The Logic: For individuals retiring on superannuation or under VRS / special VRS, the SCSS age limit is reduced to 55 years, provided the account is opened within one month of the date of receipt of retirement benefits. The Trap: 50 and 58 years are not the reduced limit, and the rule does provide a reduction for VRS retirees. Note: The one-month window from receipt of retirement benefits is a strict condition for the reduced age limit to apply.
